QuestInfo.0: You're beginning to adjust to this new world, but it'll still be a while before you're back at full strength.
QuestInfo.1: Go to the training grounds and defeat 50 training dummies.
QuestInfo.2: You feel a little stronger, but you're still nowhere near full strength.

0.0: I don't care how tired you are right now. Move on to the next lesson.

yes.0: Go to the next Training Dojo and battle the stronger familiars, Onieyes. And do try to look presentable while you do it.

1.0: Back again? At least you're dedicated.

yes.0: I'd heard you were a master of Battoujutsu, but you haven't shown me anything to be impressed with. You should continue your training.

default.0: I would like you to destroy... 20 of the Onieyes. Bring me their heads if you'd like.
